senses.gloss: m. pl. (זָקַף) officers for restoring the line of battle, guards against desertions.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 8:6">Sot. VIII, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Sotah 44a:13">44ᵃ</cite> <he>זקי׳</he>; Y. ed. <cite ref="G00628"><he>זְקוֹפִים</he></cite>, Rashi <he>זוֹקְפִין</he>).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> <he>זעקפי מלחמה</he> (read <he>זְקִיפֵי</he> or <he>זוֹקְפֵי</he>).
